description: CCP beacon format test vectors. Tests TDMA slot assignment divergence between Python (uses SFN) and Rust (ignores SFN, hardcodes 16 slots). Per spec, slot = fnv1a32(EUI64 XOR SFN) % num_slots, but implementations differ. Hash is FNV-1a32 with basis 0x811c9dc5. Also includes EMA fixed-point arithmetic edge cases.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_sfn_zero_static
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0 - both implementations should match since SFN contribution is zero

vectors.name: tdma_slot_sfn_one_divergence
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=1 - exposes divergence: Python adds SFN to hash, Rust ignores SFN

vectors.name: tdma_slot_sfn_max_wraparound
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0xFFFFFFFF (max u32) - tests wraparound behavior

vectors.name: tdma_slot_eui_one_baseline
vectors.description: Baseline slot for EUI64=0x0000000000000001 at SFN=0

vectors.name: tdma_slot_num_slots_mismatch
vectors.description: Rust ignores num_slots parameter and hardcodes 16 slots
vectors.notes: Python: 2598465490 % 8 = 2. Rust: 2598465490 % 16 = 2. Happens to match, but num_slots semantics differ.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_num_slots_divergence
vectors.description: Demonstrates num_slots divergence with different EUI
vectors.notes: Python respects num_slots=8, Rust hardcodes 16. hash % 8 != hash % 16 in general.

vectors.name: hash_32_fnv1a_single_byte
vectors.description: FNV-1a32 hash of single zero byte

vectors.name: ema_positive_samples
vectors.description: EMA calculation with positive SNR samples - Python uses float, Rust uses Q16.16 fixed-point

output.notes: Python: avg + (sample - avg) * 0.25. Rust: avg + ((sample - avg) >> 2) with saturating ops.

vectors.name: ema_negative_samples
vectors.description: EMA with negative SNR samples - right-shift of negatives may diverge

output.notes: Python float arithmetic vs Rust fixed-point right-shift on negative values. Arithmetic vs logical shift matters.

vectors.name: beacon_header_placeholder
vectors.description: 24-byte CCP beacon header format - NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in either codebase
vectors.notes: Spec says 24-byte fixed header + CBOR options + 48B Schnorr signature. Neither Python nor Rust implements the full beacon codec yet.

vectors.name: beacon_wire_example
vectors.description: Example beacon wire format for future implementation

output.notes: epoch:4B LE, num_slots:1B, sfn:4B LE, timestamp:4B truncated, flags:1B, reserved:10B zeros
